title: Yellow Crumbly Brazilian Tofu Skewers
description: A quick-fix Brazilian dish featuring umami flavors and crumbly texture, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is shojin-friendly and uses colatura for added depth.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together colatura, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Thread the marinated tofu cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the tofu cubes.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the tofu is golden brown and the bread crumbs are crispy.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
